name: Stormpike's Delivery
summary: Grimand Elmore sends travelers north with an axe for Mountaineer Gringer Stormpike. From Stormwind's Dwarven District, the road reaches an Ironforge outpost in Loch Modan.

sections.title: A Weapon for the North
sections.body: Grimand Elmore has been asked to make an axe for Mountaineer Gringer Stormpike. In Ironforge, the Stormpike clan is respected for its discerning taste and martial pride. Elmore entrusts travelers with carrying the weapon north, across the distance from Stormwind to the dwarven borderlands.

sections.title: On Guard in Loch Modan
sections.body: At Loch Modan's northern guard tower, Mountaineer Stormpike watches over lands troubled by wandering troggs and burrowing kobolds. Rumors of unrest and banditry reach the southern human kingdoms, while the dwarven frontier has dangers of its own. Stormpike needs a new blade to help keep the mountain passes secure.

faq.answer: Gringer Stormpike is an Ironforge Mountaineer of the respected Stormpike clan. He is stationed at Loch Modan's northern guard tower, defending the valley road from troggs and local threats.
The package holds a custom dwarven axe forged by Grimand Elmore. Mountaineer Stormpike commissioned it for use against troggs and kobolds in Loch Modan.

faq.q: Where do I deliver the package?
faq.answer: Carry the package to Mountaineer Stormpike at Loch Modan's northern guard tower, along the road through the hills toward the northern mountain borders.

faq.q: Why does a dwarf in Loch Modan buy weapons from Stormwind?
faq.answer: Grimand Elmore is a skilled dwarven weaponsmith in Stormwind's Dwarven District. The Stormpike clan values fine metalwork, and Gringer commissioned Elmore to make his axe despite the distance.

faq.q: How does this connect to Elmore's Task?
faq.answer: This delivery follows Elmore's Task. Grimand Elmore asks travelers to carry another favor between Stormwind and Khaz Modan.

faq.q: How do travelers reach Loch Modan from Stormwind?
aliases: how to get to loch modan
faq.answer: Take the Deeprun Tram from Stormwind's Dwarven District to Ironforge. From the Great Gates, follow the eastern highway through Dun Morogh's snowy passes and North Gate Pass into Loch Modan.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know the Stormpikes are honored among your kin. Helping a fellow mountaineer on Loch Modan's wild borders strengthens clan ties.
As a blacksmith, you can recognize the skill in Grimand Elmore's work. Mountain guards value his dwarven metalwork enough to order it across kingdoms.
As a member of the Alliance, you help carry military goods between Stormwind and the mountain outposts. Humans and dwarves rely on one another there.
